ValidationRule.description: A target subscription is required for plan changes, cancellations, equipment swaps, suspensions and portability requests.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "PlanChange"), ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Cancellation"), ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "EquipmentSwap"), ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Suspension"), ISPICKVAL(Request_Type__c, "Portability")), ISBLANK(Subscription__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A target subscription is required for this request type.
